fields.why: The 2018 table sets flavored-use prevalence (with CIs) side by side for four race/ethnicity groups.
Race/ethnicity is the only SPD with 3 or more groups; sex and school type have two levels.
The mechanical flag is a false positive: the linear and quadratic trend tests are over calendar years within school type, not across race groups, and no test is reported across race/ethnicity.
